name: unit-sdks
description: Generation harness and committed SDK output (Node, Java, Python, Ruby) for the Unit API, generated from the unit-openapi spec.

scripts.author-tests-local: npm run test-coverage && tsx scripts/agents/author-tests.ts --print-prompt | pbcopy && echo '[author-tests] prompt copied to clipboard.'
scripts.generate-sdk:node: rm -rf sdks/node && TZ=UTC openapi-generator-cli generate -i spec/openapi.bundled.json -g typescript-axios -o sdks/node -c templates/node/config.json
scripts.generate-sdk:java: rm -rf sdks/java && TZ=UTC openapi-generator-cli generate -i spec/openapi.bundled.json -g java -o sdks/java -c templates/java/config.json --openapi-generator-ignore-list "build.gradle,build.sbt,settings.gradle,gradle.properties,gradlew,gradlew.bat,gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar,gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties,git_push.sh,.travis.yml,.github/workflows/maven.yml,src/main/AndroidManifest.xml,src/test/**"
scripts.generate-sdk:python: rm -rf sdks/python && TZ=UTC openapi-generator-cli generate -i spec/openapi.bundled.json -g python -o sdks/python -c templates/python/config.json --openapi-generator-ignore-list "setup.py,setup.cfg,requirements.txt,test-requirements.txt,tox.ini,git_push.sh,.travis.yml,.gitlab-ci.yml,.github/workflows/python.yml,test/**"
scripts.generate-sdk:ruby: rm -rf sdks/ruby && TZ=UTC openapi-generator-cli generate -i spec/openapi.bundled.json -g ruby -o sdks/ruby -c templates/ruby/config.json --openapi-generator-ignore-list "git_push.sh,.travis.yml,.gitlab-ci.yml,spec/**"
scripts._test:sdk:node: npm run check-sdk-version node && npm install --prefix sdks/node --no-package-lock --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix sdks/node/tests --no-audit --no-fund && npm test --prefix sdks/node/tests
scripts._test:sdk:java: npm run check-sdk-version java && npm run place-java-tests && npm run prepare-java-sdk && tsx scripts/openapi/run-mvn.ts -f sdks/java/pom.xml '-Dtest=*IT' clean test
scripts._test:sdk:python: npm run check-sdk-version python && npm run lint:sdk:python && npm run place-python-tests && tsx scripts/openapi/run-pytest.ts
scripts._test:sdk:ruby: npm run check-sdk-version ruby && npm run place-ruby-tests && tsx scripts/openapi/run-rspec.ts
